title: phacelia sericea subsp. idahoensis
intro: Phacelia sericea subsp. idahoensis, commonly known as Idaho phacelia, is a perennial plant species native to North America. This plant is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, particularly in conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Idaho phacelia are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Idaho phacelia on human health.
